name: Google Slides (read-write, service account)
description: Google Slides, read and edit (scope presentations): presentations.create, get, batchUpdate (slides, shapes, text, images, tables, comments, …); pages.get and pages.getThumbnail. A thumbnail comes back as a contentUrl on a Google image host that drawlatch doesn't fetch; anyone holding that URL can open the image for about 30 minutes. No Drive endpoints, so it cannot share, move, export, or delete files. Auth: drawlatch signs a JWT with GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY (base64 of the service-account JSON key file) and mints short-lived access tokens for exactly this scope; the agent never sees the key. Without a subject it edits presentations shared with the service account as Editor and link-shared ones whose link grants edit. Viewer sharing makes them read-only; Commenter sharing doesn't allow content changes but may still let it comment, since batchUpdate includes insertComment and addCommentReply (not tested against Google). It cannot create presentations (service accounts own no files); with one (domain-wide delegation) every presentation that user can open, and it can create presentations owned by that user. See CONNECTIONS.md "Google (scoped)".

testConnection.description: Reads the ID of the public sample presentation from Google's Slides API quickstart (needs the Slides API enabled)
